title: Lubart's Castle
visualBrief: Lutsk Upper Castle: irregular triangular brick enclosure, west entry tower with buttresses and open round portal, north pyramid-roofed Bishop tower and southeast open-crowned Styr tower; covered timber wall walk, cream noble house, ochre columned book museum and contemporary blue-grey church excavation cover in an open court.

identityFeatures: Three differently capped square brick towers in an open triangular compound

Long dark covered timber wall walk and lower cream noble-house range
